reason: Edge is defined on intraday patterns (wedge breakouts, momentum breaks, dip-and-rip off open) that require 1-5 min bars and do not survive daily-bar approximation.

universe.description: high-beta US equities with catalysts or upgrades

setup.rule: gap up on upgrade with tight pre-market range
setup.quote: high beta stock that you know it's gapping up on an upgrade and has a really tight pre market range

setup.rule: sweep pre-market low then rebid and break pre-market high
setup.quote: they sweep and take out that pre market low rebid to pre market levels and break above the pre-market high you know the old dip and rip

entry.rule: long on break above pre-market high after dip-and-rip
entry.quote: if this is gonna go parabolic today ... it's probably gonna wedge and break out from the wedge get back up a view app and just rip

ambiguities.issue: no explicit stop or target distances given
